verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents the Automation API as a programmatic interface for running Pulumi programs without the CLI, using the engine as an SDK to create, update, configure and destroy infrastructure. A community user corroborates it as a 'killer Automation feature', and the docs also reference calling the Pulumi Cloud REST API. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show no spec at those paths; they do not contradict that the API exists. missing for 10: substantive documentation of the Pulumi Cloud REST API surface (only a page title is evidenced), a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec.
